text.title: Internal Link Audit Worked Example
text.summary: One complete audit report for a 412-page email-deliverability content site (rendered Screaming Frog crawl reconciled to a 430-URL sitemap and 445 CMS pages with the 7.4 percent CMS gap explained, contextual counts with /blog flagged as a hub, two orphans decided as rewire and redirect, a six-page cluster with two missing edges, anchor distributions with "read more" flagged, a redirect and a nofollow finding, four fully specified rewire items, three Search Console baselines and a re-measurement 61 days out) with a note per value, plus a partial-crawl report with an unactionable plan and what the validator prints.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: example.com publishes guides on email deliverability. The August 2026 audit runs a rendered Screaming Frog crawl on 2026-08-20 and finds 412 indexable pages against 430 sitemap URLs and 445 CMS pages. The site has a 60-link footer, so every page shows 412 boilerplate inlinks and the contextual column is the one that varies. One declared cluster sits under /guides/email-deliverability with six cluster pages. Two blog posts are reachable only from the sitemap. Olena K. edits the guides and needs items she can paste into the CMS.

example.title: example.com August 2026 audit
example.note: The crawl is rendered and dated inside the period; 412 against 430 sitemap URLs is a 4.2 percent gap and needs no entry, 412 against 445 CMS pages is 7.4 percent and is explained by 33 noindexed paginated archives (r-crawl-scope-reconciled). Counts are on the contextual basis with the 412 footer inlinks in their own column, which is why /blog at 380 contextual is a hub and the two posts at 0 are orphans while every page shows 412 in the boilerplate column (r-incoming-count-excludes-boilerplate). The warm-up schedule is worth keeping and gets a rewire decision with its source page and anchor, mirrored as plan item 3; the 2023 report is superseded and redirects to the 2026 edition (r-orphan-gets-a-decision). Five of six cluster pages link to the pillar so the cluster is not structurally incomplete, but the pillar does not link to dmarc-setup and feedback-loops does not link to the pillar: plan items 1 and 2 add exactly those two edges (r-pillar-cluster-reciprocity). The pillar receives "read more" on 6 of 21 inlinks, flagged generic; the two new links into dmarc-setup use different descriptive anchors rather than one repeated phrase; shares are count / total_links (r-anchor-text-descriptive). The old DMARC post redirects and the bounce checker link carries nofollow; item 4 changes the spf-records link to point at the final dmarc-setup URL rather than the redirect (r-link-targets-final-url). Every plan item names source, target, exact anchor, the paragraph, an action, Olena K. and 2026-09-30, and none targets /blog (r-rewire-item-fully-specified). Each of the three rewire targets has a 28-day Search Console baseline with its contextual count, and the re-measurement on 2026-11-30 is 61 days after the last due date with the same three metrics (r-pre-post-search-console-baseline).

example.title: partial crawl, orphans left as is, plan nobody can execute
example.note: What the validator prints: `crawl.javascript_rendered` false (r-crawl-scope-reconciled); `incoming_counts.basis` total where contextual is required (r-incoming-count-excludes-boilerplate); `orphans[0].decision` leave is not one of rewire, redirect, deindex, and `orphans[1]` decides rewire without `source_url` and `anchor_text` (r-orphan-gets-a-decision); `clusters[0].structurally_incomplete` must be true with 3 cluster-to-pillar links (r-pillar-cluster-reciprocity); "read more" and a raw URL must be flagged `generic` (r-anchor-text-descriptive); `rewire_plan[0]` has anchor "read more", placement "somewhere" below 20 characters, action strengthen outside the enum and owner team; `rewire_plan[1]` has owner content team (r-rewire-item-fully-specified); `gsc_baseline[0].window_days` 90 must be 28 and `remeasurement.metrics` has 1 of 3 (r-pre-post-search-console-baseline). Once the schema violations are fixed the cross-field checks add: the crawl date 2026-05-02 is outside the period, 250 against 430 sitemap URLs is a 41.9 percent gap with no discrepancy entry, the /blog target is an over-linked hub, the old DMARC post target is a hygiene finding's current_target, the false matrix edges have no plan items, neither rewire target has a baseline, and the re-measurement on 2026-10-05 is 5 days after the due date.
